title: API IDOR / BOLA
summary: Prove object-level authorization gaps by swapping resource IDs across identities.
steps: Pick object APIs with IDs from api_samples (users, orders, files, orgs).
Establish anonymous vs user-A vs user-B sessions when possible.
compare_requests: A’s object with B’s session (and anon); mutate one ID at a time.
On PASS: submit_finding_candidate with A/B evidence; queue_finding_followups(vuln_type='idor').
pass_signals: User B reads/modifies User A object
kill_signals: Bodies identical only for public resources
